This time of year is all about creating memories and making a difference. If you’re considering gifting for yourself or someone you love, these @raybanmeta glasses are an incredible way to capture life without stepping out of the moment.

For every pair sold using the link in my bio, I’m donating $50 to @feedingamerica to help provide meals for people facing hunger. And @meta is going to match my donation up to $250,000, to extend the impact even further.

🔗 Tap the link in my bio to pick up a pair and support a good cause along the way.

Blessings to you all!
